Weight-file I/O threads are not evidence of concurrent layer construction.
Do not describe this as an observed model-startup failure or NPU inference issue. The audit report already stated the concurrency boundary, but publication requires that boundary to remain prominent.
proposal: Hold a standalone bug issue/PR until a supported concurrency or re-entrant construction path is established. The code change can be proposed later as narrowly scoped instance-state isolation, without claiming an observed serving failure.

related.evidence: Although search indexes Kronecker/hang discussion, the final merged PR body and 748-character diff are limited to stale FusedMoE factory bindings in patch_fused_moe.py; it is not a solver fix.

confidence: High confidence that the real helper never terminates for 6 and 1026; medium confidence in deduplication and low confidence that those examples represent supported checkpoints.
caveats: CPU execution still exceeds the deterministic source-line budget only for dimensions 6 and 1026; the existing bounded-factor patch passes all seven shape cases, including legacy 40/56 layouts.

The INT4 FlatQuant caller requires divisibility by 8 and cannot reach this case. The MXFP4 host caller checks only divisibility by 2 before calling the helper, but the example widths 6 and 1026 do not satisfy the default MXFP4 group_size=32 packing geometry. No supported ModelSlim checkpoint with these dimensions has been established.

Do not infer that passing this host-side check means every downstream NPU operator supports the resulting factors. The original patch adds a factorization path; a publication-ready patch must decide whether the supported contract requires accepting these factors or rejecting an invalid configuration early.
The legacy difference-of-squares/Fermat layout must remain unchanged for already supported dimensions: 56 maps to (4, 14), not (7, 8).
proposal: Hold the current acceptance-expanding PR pending the supported shape contract. If publishing only the helper/configuration robustness problem, clearly state that malformed or unsupported dimensions can hang initialization and prefer an explicitly justified fail-fast guard; do not claim a stock supported model failure.
